actions.output:
IXIAN PROVING GROUND // STATIC ACTION

This result was returned directly from extension.json. No child process ran.

SIDEBAR
  Sidecar tools shows manifest probes with readiness and versions.
  Capability actions exposes only advertised, fixed action IDs.

MAIN PANE
  Protocol surface is the generic summary panel.
  Action result displays captured output, exit code, duration, and errors.

CONTROLS
  Select an action and press Enter.
  Long lines wrap to the pane width automatically.
  Wheel, j/k, arrows, PgUp/PgDn, and Home/End scroll vertically.
  Extension selection, action selection, and vertical position persist while switching pages.

BOUNDARY
  Command actions run as the ixian user inside this read-only sidecar in Docker mode.
  The sidecar has its own filesystem and process context, a small /tmp tmpfs, and only the shared extension network.
  It has no workspace mount, Fremen home, Docker socket, devices, secrets, capabilities, or arbitrary command input.
